title: General.
officialText:
Roof decks shall be covered with approved roof coverings secured to the building or structure in accordance with
the provisions of this chapter. Roof coverings shall be designed and installed in accordance with this code and the approved
manufacturer’s instructions such that the roof covering shall serve to protect the building or structure.
